mapper.insert: INSERT INTO javdb_movie ( code, title, cover_url, release_date, duration, director, studio, publisher, series, actors, genres, description, detail_url, raw_html, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{title}, #{coverUrl}, #{releaseDate}, #{duration}, #{director}, #{studio}, #{publisher}, #{series}, #{actors}, #{genres}, #{description}, #{detailUrl}, #{rawHtml}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), cover_url = VALUES(cover_url), release_date = VALUES(release_date), duration = VALUES(duration), director = VALUES(director), studio = VALUES(studio), publisher = VALUES(publisher), series = VALUES(series), actors = VALUES(actors), genres = VALUES(genres), description = VALUES(description), detail_url = VALUES(detail_url), updated_at = NOW()
